Elena — thanks, noted. Long version below; short version: acceptance criteria + eval plan attached (Finera_MAP_v2.xlsx, eval_plan.md).

MAP snapshot (current):
- Trial window: 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-04 (2-week POC)
- Primary success metrics: functional coverage, latency/throughput, cost-per-token, and end-to-end correctness on our curated prompts

Explicit acceptance criteria (proposed):
1) Performance: 95th percentile request latency <= 350 ms for 6 req/s steady-state on dedicated pool (measured across 1k representative prompts)
2) Quality: Weighted top-1 match >= 92% on the agreed evaluation prompt set (see eval_plan.md)
3) Cost: Inference unit cost <= $0.0009 per token for production config (batching + kv-cache enabled)
4) Reliability: No single-day outage exceeding 5 minutes during the trial window; end-to-end retries and fallback exercised in canary traffic

Open blockers we know about:
- GPU quota: we requested a temporary Dedicated pool increase (ticket filed, see attachment).
- Dataset access: Finera will provide redacted sample (Ben — can you confirm S3 path + IAM role by EOD Monday?)
- Eval harness: we'll need the final prompt set and acceptance labeling by Fri 4/17 to hit the timeline.

Action items (owners + dates):
- Rachel: Share updated MAP workbook and eval_plan.md (attached) — due 2026-04-16 (done).
- Ben (Finera): Confirm S3 data access + IAM role — due 2026-04-17.
- Aditya: Validate Dedicated pool config & run baseline latency tests — due 2026-04-19.
- Marissa: Stand up test harness and define scoring script (open-sourceable) — due 2026-04-19.

Meeting: Weekly MAP checkpoint scheduled Wed 2026-04-21 10:00 PT (invites sent). We'll review baseline test results, confirm acceptance thresholds, and list any remaining blockers.

Attachments: Finera_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook), eval_plan.md (evaluation steps & scripts)

Quick tech update and blockers from my side:

1) GPU quota (blocking for performance runs)
- Raised a quota increase request with infra on 4/16; they've provisionally approved but we need the account-level justification for a temporary Dedicated bump. I attached the pdf to include in procurement.

2) Model variance w/ quantization
- Our internal tests show a small quality delta when moving from float16 to 4-bit quantization on this model family (~1.2% top-1 loss on our synthetic eval set). That is within a tolerable range but could impact the 92% threshold in corner cases. Mitigation: run a short A/B with higher-precision in the first 48 hours to compare behavior.

3) Data ingestion scope
- Need the final list of prompt templates and expected labels. If Finera can confirm the S3 prefix by EOD 4/17 I'll stage a consumer and seed the harness.

Next steps from infra: I will kick off a baseline run on 4/19 (non-production) and publish a small report prior to the Wed checkpoint.

Looping in a few notes for the evaluation plan so the acceptance gate is unambiguous. Quoting Rachel's criteria above and adding runbook items: 

> Acceptance criteria (proposed):
> 1) Performance: 95th percentile request latency <= 350 ms for 6 req/s steady-state
> 2) Quality: Weighted top-1 match >= 92% on the agreed evaluation prompt set
> 3) Cost: Inference unit cost <= $0.0009 per token
> 4) Reliability: No single-day outage exceeding 5 minutes

Eval plan additions (Marissa):
- Scoring: We'll compute weighted top-1 on three buckets (core prompts, edge-case prompts, and adversarial samples). Each bucket has its own weight in the final score; I put the exact weights in eval_plan.md.
- Acceptance run: Two-stage acceptance — (A) canary traffic (5% of trial traffic) for 48 hrs with monitoring hooks; (B) full trial traffic after canary passes.
- Labeling: Finera labels will be the source of truth; Redwood will implement a reconciliation script to compute the final metric.
- Escalation: If weighted top-1 drops >2% between canary and full traffic, automatic rollback to fallback model.

Owners (restated):
- Eval harness & scoring script: Marissa — 2026-04-19 (on track).
- Baseline performance tests: Aditya — 2026-04-19.
- S3 access + labels: Ben/Finera — 2026-04-17.
- Procurement/Quota playbook: Rachel — coordinate with Finera Procurement.

I will bring the scoring script and a dry-run report to the Wed checkpoint.

-Marissa
